name: Final Inspection
tagline: Day 30. One inspector. One clipboard. One visit.
notes: Plays when the player goes to bed on the last week (day 30). This is Inspector Dan's first and only visit to the house: inspectors don't drop by weekly, so nothing here may call back to an earlier visit (the player has only heard him on the week-3 podcast). The house passes only if all four maladies are fixed (housefixed, i.e. fixedcount == storycount); the game uses the same rule to decide whether the finale podcast plays. On a fail, Dan walks to each room that is still broken (kitchen, bedroom closet, bathroom, living room, in that order) via single conditional choices, so the scene names exactly what's unfinished.

lines: *{sfx:DoorKnock} Day 30. Inspection day. Inspector Dan is on the porch with a clipboard, a windbreaker and a brand-new pair of waterproof shoes.*
Dan: First time inside. I've read the file, I've heard the podcast, and I've dressed for it. Final inspection. Let's see what we've got.
*{sfx:PipeClank} The kitchen. He checks every pipe, knocks on the walls and peers under the sink for a long time.*
Dan: Not a single leak. You've really turned the tide on this place.
*The bedroom closet. Bare studs, fresh drywall, no smell at all. He sniffs anyway.*
Dan: No fungus among us. I had a whole moldy-oldie bit ready from the radio. I'll use it spore-adically.
*{sfx:SwitchOn} The living room. He flips every switch in the house. Nothing flickers. Nothing sparks. Nothing apologizes.*
Dan: Rewired, up to code. A real watt-ershed moment.
*The bathroom. He runs a thumb along the grout of the old pink tile and smiles.*
Dan: Restored, regrouted, sealed. Seventy years old and not a crack in her. I'll say it once and I'll tile it again: she's a keeper.
*He waits for a laugh. The whole house holds its breath, very politely.*
Dan: {sfx:FixComplete}Congratulations. 12 Heartbreak Lane passes. Every room. I'll tell the council this afternoon it's the safest house on the street. And my shoes are dry. I almost feel cheated.
*{sfx:DoorKnock} Day 30. Inspection day. Inspector Dan is on the porch with a clipboard and a brand-new pair of waterproof shoes. He looks up at the gutters and stops smiling.*
Dan: First time inside, final inspection. Every room, top to bottom. The council wants my report this afternoon.

choices.text: Follow him to the living room.

lines: *He goes straight to the kitchen sink.*
*{sfx:TapDrip} Drip. Drip. Drip.*
*{sfx:WaterSplash} Something under the sink lets go, and both of his brand-new waterproof shoes fill up with water.*
Dan: Ah. That's an active leak. Waterproof, they said. These shoes are a pipe dream.
*Behind him, the tap drips once more. It sounds almost apologetic.*

choices.text: Follow him to the living room.

lines: *He opens the bedroom closet. The back wall is velvet black, and it seems to be sulking.*
Dan: Black mold. A fungus among us. ...I said that on the radio. It was funnier on the radio.
*{sfx:Squelch} Something in the closet sighs, at length.*

choices.text: Follow him to the living room.

lines: *{sfx:TileCrack} He taps the pink tile by the tub. It's cracked. Water's been getting in behind it, and two tiles come away in his hand.*
Dan: Loose, cracked, and the wall behind it's soft. I'd love to call it a keeper. Tile be honest with you, I can't.
*He puts the tiles back very gently, like he's apologizing to them.*

choices.text: Follow him to the living room.

lines: *He flips the living-room switch. The lamp flickers, nervously. {sfx:Spark}Somewhere in the wall, something sparks and then goes very quiet.*
Dan: That's a fire waiting for a cold night. I don't have a pun for that one. I looked.
*Dan stands in the hall and writes for a long time.*
Dan: I'm sorry. I really am. It's so close. But I can only sign off a house that's fixed for real, every room of it.
Dan: I'll have to recommend the demolition goes ahead.
